contest.name: Atlantic Canada QSO Party
contest.description: Atlantic Canada QSO Party — first Sunday of June, 11-hour event (1400Z Sunday to 0100Z Monday). Atlantic Canada stations (Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, Newfoundland & Labrador) work everyone; out-of-region stations work Atlantic Canada stations only. Exchange is RST + 5-letter province+county/division code for AC stations (e.g. NSANP, NBKGS, NLASJ), RST + 2-letter state/province for out-of-region W/VE, or RST + DX for DX stations. SSB and CW only — no digital modes. Phone QSO = 1 point, CW QSO = 1 point. Multipliers per band: out-of-region stations multiply by AC counties/divisions (47 max — NS-18, NB-15, PE-3, NL-11); AC stations multiply by US states (50, DC=MD) + 13 Canadian provinces/territories (63 max). DX stations do not count as multipliers. Bonus stations: VE1RAC, VE9RAC, VY2RAC, VO1RAC, VO2RAC, VEOCNM, VE0MMA, VO1ACQ, VE9ACQ, VA1ACQ are each worth 5 bonus points per band/mode. Final score is (QSO points × multipliers) + bonus points. Cabrillo CONTEST tag: AC-QSO-PARTY
contest.startDate: First Sunday of June (2026: June 7, 1400Z Sun to 0100Z Mon)

userPrompts.question: Select your station location
userPrompts.description: Atlantic Canada stations work everyone; non-AC stations work AC stations only. Your specific AC province is conveyed by the 5-letter province+county/division code you send (e.g. NSANP identifies you as a Nova Scotia Annapolis station).

userPrompts.question: Select your operating class

options.label: Mobile (in-region only) — antennas usable while in motion
Portable (in-region only) — deployed antennas, any power source

userPrompts.description: Spotting assistance and self-spotting are permitted in all categories. Mobile/Portable classes apply to in-region stations only. Mobile and Portable may be split into Single- and Multi-Op subcategories by the committee if entries warrant.

userPrompts.question: Enter your exchange. AC stations: 5-letter province+county/division (e.g. NSANP, NBKGS, PEKGS, NLASJ). Non-AC W/VE: 2-letter state/province. DX: DX.
userPrompts.description: 5-letter province+county/division code for AC stations; 2-letter state/province for non-AC W/VE; DX otherwise. AC Mobile/Portable stations must update this when crossing into a new county/division.

sent.name: EXCHs
sent.description: 5-letter province+county/division for AC stations; 2-letter state/province for non-AC W/VE; DX otherwise

received.name: EXCHr
received.description: 5-letter province+county/division from AC stations; 2-letter state/province from non-AC W/VE; DX from DX stations

multipliers.description: Multipliers count per band. Out-of-region stations multiply by AC counties/divisions only (max 47 per band). AC stations multiply by US states (50, DC=MD) + 13 Canadian provinces/territories (max 63 per band) — the 5-letter codes received from other AC stations are reduced to the 2-letter province code via multAliases so they count as a single province multiplier per band per the rules ('first VA/VE1, VE9, VO1/2, or VY2 station worked on each band and mode, including their own province'). An AC operator who works another own-province station earns their own province multiplier via the alias path — no separate auto-credit is applied. DX is not a multiplier in either direction.

bonusStations.name: Atlantic Canada QSO Party Bonus Stations
bonusStations.note: Each RAC/club bonus station is worth 5 bonus points per band per mode. Best efforts are made to confirm planned operations via the ACQP website before the event; specific operations are not guaranteed.

dupeChecking.description: Work each station once per band per mode (CW and SSB are separate). AC Mobiles/Portables that change counties/divisions are considered new stations and may be re-worked. County/division line operations: a separate QSO and complete exchange must be logged for each county/division. CW contacts must not be made in phone band segments. Cross-mode, cross-band, and repeater QSOs are not permitted. No digital modes.

callHistory.description: Save received exchange (county/division or state/province) for future lookups

multAliases.comment: When the operator is in Atlantic Canada, received 5-letter province+county/division codes (NSANP, NBKGS, PEKGS, NLASJ, etc.) are reduced to their 2-letter province prefix so they count as a single province multiplier per band per the ACQP rules ('They will receive a provincial multiplier for the first VA/VE1, VE9, VO1/2, or VY2 station worked on each band and mode, including their own province'). Out-of-region operators (OUTSIDE / DX) don't trigger this rule and instead see each county/division as a separate multiplier per band (per the receivedExchangeFilter).

exchangeValidation.description: Exchange should be a 5-letter province+county/division code for AC stations, a 2-letter US state or Canadian province code for non-AC W/VE (DC counts as MD), or DX for DX stations. AC operators may receive DX from DX stations — DX is not a multiplier but is a valid received exchange.
